properties.areaDesc: Dallam, TX; Hartley, TX
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 26 at 6:54AM CDT until October 26 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Southeastern Dallam County in the panhandle of Texas...
Northeastern Hartley County in the panhandle of Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings are inundated
with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 654 AM CDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area. Flooding is already occurring. Between 3 and 4
inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dalhart and Hartley.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.areaDesc: Cheyenne; Rawlins; Decatur; Norton; Sherman; Thomas; Sheridan; Graham; Dundy; Hitchcock; Red Willow
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 26 at 6:50AM CDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
Widespread fog is reducing visibility under 3 miles with transient
dense patches reducing visibility down to less than 1/4 mile. These
conditions are forecast to gradually improve over the next couple of
hours. As of 545 AM MT / 645 AM CT, the Goodland, Norton, and Oberlin
airports are reporting 1/4 mile, or less, visibility in dense fog.

Reduced visibility is a hazard while traveling. Turn on headlights
and add extra time into the commute this morning.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.
